name: commlink-prototype
description: Private CommLink mailbox and MCP event subscription prototype for HUB-300.

interface.longDescription: Read your CommLink mailbox and receive signed events in the existing owning dot. Includes roles-and-tiers dispatch and completion-reporting skills with inactive, default-deny standing permissions. A skill alone is not a completion wake source. Cloudflare Access provides OAuth login; Linear records scope and evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my CommLink inbox and report pending messages.
